title: CLI Tool (basicc)
description: Implement the command-line interface for the Turbo BASIC compiler at /cmd/basicc. The CLI is the user-facing entry point. Commands/modes: 'basicc compile <file.bas>' (compile to native via Go transpile+go build), 'basicc transpile <file.bas>' (output Go source code), 'basicc run <file.bas>' (compile and execute immediately), 'basicc vm <file.bas>' (run via bytecode VM). Flags: --output/-o (output file path), --target (go|bytecode|native), --verbose/-v (show compilation stages), --ast (dump AST for debugging), --tokens (dump token stream), --no-optimize (disable optimizations), --version, --help. Must provide clear error output with source locations. Use Go flag package or cobra for argument parsing.

Global flags: --output/-o (output file path, default: input basename with .go/.exe), --verbose/-v (show compilation stages: lexing, parsing, analysis, codegen), --version (print version and exit), --help. Debug flags: --dump-tokens (print token stream and exit), --dump-ast (print AST tree and exit), --dump-bytecode (print bytecode disassembly, VM mode only). Use Go standard flag package or cobra. Wire up the full pipeline: read source file, create lexer, parse, analyze, generate code, optional go build step. Handle and display errors clearly with source file, line, column.

title: Implement compile and run pipeline integration
description: Wire up the end-to-end compilation pipeline in the CLI. Transpile mode: lexer -> parser -> semantic analysis -> Go codegen -> write .go file -> run gofmt on output. Compile mode: same as transpile + invoke 'go build' on the generated .go file to produce a native binary, handle go build errors and relay them to the user. Run mode: same as compile + execute the resulting binary, capture and display stdout/stderr, clean up temporary files. VM mode: lexer -> parser -> semantic analysis -> bytecode compiler -> VM execution. Handle include files ( metacommand): resolve relative paths, prevent circular includes, pre-process before main compilation. Implement a clean error reporting pipeline that collects errors from all stages and presents them sorted by source position with context lines.

title: Implement runtime string functions
description: Create /internal/runtime/strings.go implementing all Turbo BASIC string functions with exact BASIC semantics. LEFT(s, n): return first n chars (return full string if n > len). RIGHT(s, n): return last n chars. MID(s, start, len): 1-based substring (BASIC strings are 1-indexed). INSTR(start, s, find): find substring position, 1-based result, 0 if not found. LEN(s): string length. ASC(s): ASCII value of first char. CHR(n): character from ASCII code. STR(n): number to string with leading space for positive numbers. VAL(s): string to number, stop at first non-numeric char. HEX(n)/OCT(n)/BIN(n): integer to hex/octal/binary string. UCASE/LCASE: case conversion. LTRIM/RTRIM/TRIM: whitespace removal. SPACE(n): n spaces. STRING_FUNC(n, c): n copies of character. MKI/MKL/MKS/MKD and CVI/CVL/CVS/CVD: binary data packing/unpacking using encoding/binary.

title: Implement bytecode compiler (AST to bytecode)
description: Create /internal/vm/compiler.go that translates the analyzed AST into bytecode. Implement: Compiler struct (instructions []Instruction, constants pool, variable table, label addresses), Compile(program) method. Expression compilation: emit push for literals, load/store for variables, operator opcodes for binary/unary expressions, function call opcodes for built-ins. Statement compilation: PRINT emits expression evaluation + OP_PRINT, IF emits condition + conditional jump + then-block + optional else-block jump, FOR emits init + condition-check-jump + body + increment + back-jump, WHILE/DO similarly, GOTO emits OP_JMP, GOSUB emits OP_GOSUB. SUB/FUNCTION: emit as callable code blocks with OP_CALL/OP_RET. Handle forward jumps via backpatching (emit placeholder address, fill in when target is known). Build constant pool for string and large numeric literals.
close_reason: Bytecode compiler implemented in internal/vm/compiler.go (195 lines). Compiles AST to bytecode with expression/statement compilation, backpatching for forward jumps, constant pool.

title: Implement VM execution engine
description: Create /internal/vm/vm.go with the bytecode execution engine. Implement: VM struct (instructions, ip (instruction pointer), operand stack, call stack with frames, global variables map, local variable frames, constant pool, data pool for DATA/READ). Execute() method: fetch-decode-execute loop that reads instruction at ip, dispatches to handler based on opcode, advances ip. Stack operations: push/pop with type checking. Call frames: on OP_CALL push frame with return address and local variable space, on OP_RET pop frame and restore ip. GOSUB/RETURN: separate gosub stack. Error handling: ON ERROR sets error handler address, runtime errors check for handler and jump if set, RESUME/RESUME NEXT adjust ip. Memory management: string values reference-counted or garbage collected. Add execution limits (max stack depth, max instructions) to prevent infinite loops during development.
